[Pending Restart] [Elune] [Winds of Winter] - Winds of Winter now reduces the damage when hitting 3 or more targets. Hitting 3 targets will result in 3 hits, each hit being equal to the damage it would deal to a single target. The total damage past 3 targets will be increased by half a target for every target added. This means that when hitting 10 targets, Winds of Winter hit will deal 6.5 targets worth of damage, each hit of the 10 targets being hit equal to 65% of what it would have done to a single target. Hitting more than 10 targets does not increase the overall damage done from Winds of Winter, this is unchanged.
